import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int N;
    static List<String> gridA, gridB;
    static List<List<Integer>> shortest_paths;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int u, v;
        int capacity, cost;
        FlowEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int c) {
            u = from;
            v = to;
            capacity = cap;
            cost = c;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int n;
        List<Integer> dist, prev_flow, prev_edge;
        List<FlowEdge> edges;
        int max_flow, min_cost;

        void setup(int size) {
            n = size;
            dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
            prev_flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            prev_edge = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, -1));
        }

        void link(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(from, to, cap, cost));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(to, from, 0, -cost));
        }

        void spfa(int src, int dst) {
            setup(n);
            prev_flow.set(src, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist.set(src, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(src);
            boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[n];
            Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
            in_queue[src] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                in_queue[u] = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); ++i) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && dist.get(e.v) > dist.get(e.u) + e.cost) {
                        dist.set(e.v, dist.get(e.u) + e.cost);
                        prev_flow.set(e.v, Math.min(prev_flow.get(e.u), e.capacity));
                        prev_edge.set(e.v, i);
                        if (!in_queue[e.v]) {
                            q.offer(e.v);
                            in_queue[e.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void solve(int src, int dst) {
            if (src == dst) {
                max_flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                min_cost = 0;
                return;
            }
            max_flow = 0;
            min_cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                spfa(src, dst);
                if (prev_flow.get(dst) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = dst; cur != src; cur = edges.get(prev_edge.get(cur)).u) {
                    int rev = prev_edge.get(cur) ^ 1;
                    FlowEdge forward = edges.get(prev_edge.get(cur));
                    FlowEdge backward = edges.get(rev);
                    forward.capacity -= prev_flow.get(dst);
                    backward.capacity += prev_flow.get(dst);
                    min_cost += edges.get(prev_edge.get(cur)).cost * prev_flow.get(dst);
                }
                max_flow += prev_flow.get(dst);
            }
        }
    }

    static final int IN_NODE(int x) { return 2 * (x); }
    static final int OUT_NODE(int x) { return 2 * (x) + 1; }

    static MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow();
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int[] dirX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void bfs_search(int sx, int sy, List<List<Integer>> dist) {
        dist.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            dist.add(row);
        }
        dist.get(sx).set(sy, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(sx * N + sy);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur / N, y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dirX[i], ny = y + dirY[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || dist.get(nx).get(ny) != -1 || gridA.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && gridB.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' && 
                    (dist.get(x).get(y) + 1 <= shortest_paths.get(nx).get(ny) || shortest_paths.get(nx).get(ny) == -1)) {
                    dist.get(nx).set(ny, dist.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    if (dist.get(nx).get(ny) != shortest_paths.get(nx).get(ny)) {
                        q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                    }
                } else if (shortest_paths.get(nx).get(ny) == -1 || shortest_paths.get(nx).get(ny) > dist.get(x).get(y) + 1) {
                    dist.get(nx).set(ny, dist.get(x).get(y) + 1);
                    q.offer(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build_distance_tables(List<String> m, List<List<List<Integer>>> all_dists) {
        all_dists.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            List<List<Integer>> dist = new ArrayList<>();
            all_dists.add(dist);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0')
                    bfs_search(i, j, all_dists.get(i * N + j));
    }

    static void connect_nodes(int i1, int j1, int i2, int j2) {
        int u = i1 * N + j1;
        int v = i2 * N + j2 + N * N;
        mcf.link(OUT_NODE(u), IN_NODE(v), 1000000, 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        N = n;
        List<String> A = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> B = new ArrayList<>();
        int start_x = -1, start_y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            A.add(sc.next());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (A.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    start_x = i;
                    start_y = j;
                }
        }
        gridA = A;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) B.add(sc.next());
        gridB = B;
        List<List<Integer>> temp_dist = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> all_dists = new ArrayList<>();
        shortest_paths = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                row.add(INF);
            }
            shortest_paths.add(row);
        }
        bfs_search(start_x, start_y, temp_dist);
        shortest_paths = temp_dist;
        build_distance_tables(A, all_dists);
        mcf.setup(4 * N * N + 2);
        int source = 4 * N * N, sink = source + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            mcf.link(source, IN_NODE(i), 1000000, 0);
            mcf.link(OUT_NODE(N * N + i), sink, 1000000, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    mcf.link(IN_NODE(idx), OUT_NODE(idx), 0, A.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j + N * N;
                    mcf.link(IN_NODE(idx), OUT_NODE(idx), 0, B.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j)
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j)) && B.get(i).charAt(j) != '0')
                    for (int k = 0; k < all_dists.size(); ++k)
                        if (!all_dists.get(k).isEmpty()) {
                            int x = k / N, y = k % N;
                            if (all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) > t) continue;
                            connect_nodes(x, y, i, j);
                        }
        mcf.solve(source, sink);
        System.out.println(mcf.max_flow);
    }
}
